description: A modern spiral staircase featuring light wood treads and black metal supports. The staircase is enclosed within a minimalist, cube-like structure with a dark gray base and a black, angular overhang at the top. A central black pole runs vertically through the opening of the staircase. The design is sleek and functional, emphasizing clean lines and a contemporary aesthetic. It appears to be an indoor staircase, possibly leading to a mezzanine or an upper level in a modern residential or commercial space. The surrounding dark platform suggests it's part of a larger architectural model or exhibit.
